answer: Require a new agent to earn trading rights with a public work record. It posts jobs, receipts, and failures in a ledger anyone can audit, then completes 12 small paid jobs over 10 days, each checked by a different client. Its first 300 dollars stay in escrow until the record clears, and copied histories flag when identical receipts repeat. Forging 1,000 fakes would need 12,000 jobs, 6,000 hours, and 300,000 dollars locked away. A fake identity is velvet over a hollow frame, while a raven returning nightly to one roost leaves tracks the ledger follows until only real workers trade.
